mechanism: the V projection is relocated after the last Q/K read and stores into the retired Q plane; V token ownership {8t,8t+32} -> {16t,16t+16) makes the Q-read -> V-write WAR intra-subgroup (cross-subgroup 0). Workgroup shared memory 24576 -> 16384 B, residency 2 -> 4 per SM.

e_class_record.symptom: tier1 fixed gate FAILED (frame c0b498640ff4e373... vs gold 1755e9c2...); the base arm passed both gates and the plan was verified 16 rows / shared 16384, so it was not a wiring problem
e_class_record.root_cause: the PV A-operand reads address the V plane with an INTRA-SECTION literal VBASE (`+ 4096u`), which is not the section stride `(gl_SubgroupID/4u) * 6144u`. The candidate updated the stride to 4096 but left the literal, so PV read base+4096: 4096 half past the head section, and for the second head 8192..10239 of an 8192-half declaration, i.e. out of bounds
e_class_record.detection: added `_addr_audit.py` (build/addr-audit.json). It strips the section base from every qkv access and checks (1) the plane literal is in the arm's allowed set (parent {0,2048,4096}, candidate {0,2048}), (2) the section stride, (3) the access families are present (V store with vt, Q^T load with qg, at least 16 PV sites). On the buggy build it reports FAIL and names the 16 PV lines; on the fixed build it PAsses
e_class_record.fix: 16 PV A-operand VBASE literals 4096u -> 0u per group, an asserted edit with an exact count in _make_candidates.py
e_class_record.why_the_other_checks_missed_it: storage-byte drop, spv_validate, parent byte reproduction, coopmat/NC multiset identity and the hazard model are all blind to a wrong address constant: the model used the intended offsets, not the source text
e_class_record.lesson: any card that moves a shared-memory plane must (a) record "plane literal" and "section stride" as two different quantities and (b) run an address base audit over every access before a GPU round
